work: PRED-0015: Delivery-route biomarker compartmentalization benchmark across early-phase PRISMA-included Cystic Fibrosis interventional trials in tools/trial_atlas/snapshot.json.

claims.statement: tools/trial_atlas/snapshot.json contains 1,053 INTERVENTIONAL records and 940 PRISMA-included Cystic Fibrosis interventional studies after excluding 72 X4 condition-omission records and 41 X5 negated-CF records.

methods.name: scope.py regex PRISMA classifier
methods.difference: applies tools/trial_atlas/scope.py regular expressions to snapshot study records

methods.name: regex-free character token-window + directory cross-check
methods.difference: separate file with zero re or trial_atlas imports; scans alphanumeric token windows and checks data/care_team_trials_directory.json

claims.statement: Among 54 early-phase non-healthy-volunteer PRISMA-included systemic CFTR modulator and systemic PTC readthrough trials in tools/trial_atlas/snapshot.json, 7 (0.129630) register sweat chloride as a primary outcome in primary_outcomes[].measure.

methods.name: word-boundary regex regimen and measure classifier
methods.difference: classifies interventions and primary_outcomes[].measure with compiled regular expressions

methods.name: regex-free structured intervention token scanner
methods.difference: separate file with zero re imports; inspects typed DRUG/BIOLOGICAL/GENETIC intervention dicts via lowercase alphanumeric token tuples

claims.statement: Among 17 early-phase non-healthy-volunteer PRISMA-included airway-restricted CFTR-restoring genetic, mRNA, viral-vector, liposomal, and splice-ASO trials in tools/trial_atlas/snapshot.json (15 excluding dual-route modulator co-administration), 0 (0.000000) register primary sweat chloride while 16 of 17 (0.941176) register primary airway or safety outcomes.

methods.name: word-boundary regex investigational-route classifier
methods.difference: applies investigational-route precedence regular expressions to study titles, keywords, and interventions

methods.name: regex-free proximity token-window scanner
methods.difference: separate file with zero re imports; checks 12-token proximity windows and named candidate tuples

claims.statement: Comparing 7/54 systemic vs 0/17 airway-restricted early-phase CFTR-restoring trials yields one-sided Fisher hypergeometric p = 160272/1203521 (0.13316926) and two-sided Fisher p = 20212/109411 (0.18473462).

methods.name: math.comb hypergeometric support summation
methods.difference: computes combinatorial hypergeometric mass terms via math.comb

methods.name: multiplicative Fraction product summation
methods.difference: computes binomial coefficients via multiplicative Fraction products without importing math

claims.statement: The Chan-Zhang (1999) unconditional two-sided 95% risk-difference confidence interval for 7/54 systemic minus 0/17 airway-restricted early-phase CFTR-restoring trials is [-0.078380, 0.252184], with lower bound -0.078380.

methods.name: trigonometric Cardano cubic restricted-MLE + golden-section supremum
methods.difference: solves Miettinen-Nurminen cubic via math.acos/math.cos and refines nuisance p2 via golden-section search

methods.name: polynomial score-derivative bisection + ternary nuisance supremum
methods.difference: solves cleared-denominator log-likelihood derivative by monotone bisection without trigonometry and refines nuisance p2 via ternary search

claims.statement: The Newcombe-Wilson Method-10 two-sided 95% risk-difference confidence interval for 7/54 systemic minus 0/17 airway-restricted early-phase CFTR-restoring trials is [-0.065945, 0.244217], with lower bound -0.065945.

methods.name: IEEE-754 float64 Newcombe-Wilson Method 10
methods.difference: computes single-arm Wilson limits and Euclidean difference intervals in float64

methods.name: 50-digit Decimal.sqrt Newcombe-Wilson Method 10
methods.difference: computes Wilson limits and root-sum-of-squares bounds in 50-digit decimal.Decimal arithmetic

claims.statement: Pre-registered PRED-0015 hypothesis (one-sided Fisher hypergeometric p < 0.01 and unconditional / Newcombe-Wilson 95% risk-difference CI lower bound > 0 on flattened primary_outcomes[].measure) is refuted: observed proportions are 7/54 (0.129630) vs 0/17 (0.000000), p_fisher_1s = 160272/1203521 = 0.13316926 >= 0.01, Chan-Zhang 95% CI [-0.078380, 0.252184], and Newcombe-Wilson 95% CI [-0.065945, 0.244217] because early-phase systemic CFTR trials predominantly register safety/PK as primary outcomes and place sweat chloride in secondary outcomes omitted from snapshot.json.
